name: SpheresFactory
description: Engine for spitting spheres based on mass flow rate, particle size distribution etc. Initial velocity of particles is given by *vMin*, *vMax*, the *massFlowRate* determines how many particles to generate at each step. When *goalMass* is attained or positive *maxParticles* is reached, the engine...

attributes.name: massFlowRate
attributes.description: Mass flow rate [kg/s]

attributes.name: rMin
attributes.description: Minimum radius of generated spheres (uniform distribution)

attributes.name: rMax
attributes.description: Maximum radius of generated spheres (uniform distribution)

attributes.name: vMin
attributes.description: Minimum velocity norm of generated spheres (uniform distribution)

attributes.name: vMax
attributes.description: Maximum velocity norm of generated spheres (uniform distribution)

attributes.name: vAngle
attributes.description: Maximum angle by which the initial sphere velocity deviates from the normal.

attributes.name: normal
attributes.description: Orientation of the region's geometry, direction of particle's velocites if normalVel is not set.

attributes.name: normalVel
attributes.description: Direction of particle's velocites.

attributes.name: materialId
attributes.description: Shared material id to use for newly created spheres (can be negative to count from the end)

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: groupMask to apply for newly created spheres

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Use the color for newly created particles, if specified

attributes.name: ids
attributes.description: ids of created bodies

attributes.name: totalMass
attributes.description: Mass of spheres that was produced so far. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: totalVolume
attributes.description: Volume of spheres that was produced so far. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: goalMass
attributes.description: Total mass that should be attained at the end of the current step. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: maxParticles
attributes.description: The number of particles at which to stop generating new ones regardless of massFlowRate. if maxParticles=-1 - this parameter is ignored .

attributes.name: maxMass
attributes.description: Maximal mass at which to stop generating new particles regardless of massFlowRate. if maxMass=-1 - this parameter is ignored.

attributes.name: numParticles
attributes.description: Cummulative number of particles produces so far (auto-updated)

attributes.name: maxAttempt
attributes.description: Maximum number of attempts to position a new sphere randomly.

attributes.name: silent
attributes.description: If true no complain about excessing maxAttempt but disable the factory (by set massFlowRate=0).

attributes.name: blockedDOFs
attributes.description: Blocked degress of freedom

attributes.name: PSDsizes
attributes.description: PSD-dispersion, sizes of cells, Diameter [m]

attributes.name: PSDcum
attributes.description: PSD-dispersion, cumulative procent meanings [-]

attributes.name: PSDcalculateMass
attributes.description: PSD-Input is in mass (true), otherwise the number of particles will be considered.

attributes.name: stopIfFailed
attributes.description: If true, the SpheresFactory stops (sets massFlowRate=0), when maximal number of attempts to insert particle exceed.

attributes.name: exactDiam
attributes.description: If true, the particles only with the defined in PSDsizes diameters will be created. Otherwise the diameter will be randomly chosen in the range [PSDsizes[i-1]:PSDsizes[i]], in this case the length of PSDsizes should be more on 1, than the length of PSDcum.

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
